title: President of India Awards President’s Medal for Distinguished Services & Medal for Meritorious Service
subtitle:
Shri Rajesh Lal, Assistant Security Commissioner, Railway Board Receives President's Medal for Distinguished Service
15 Officers/Officials Receive Medal for Meritorious Service
body_text:
On the occasion of Independence Day 2026, the Hon'ble President of India has awarded President's Medal for Distinguished Service (PSM) and Medal for Meritorious Service (MSM) to the following Officers and staff of RPF/RPSF:
President's Medal for Distinguished Service (PSM):
1. Shri Rajesh Lal, Assistant Security Commissioner, Railway Board
Medal for Meritorious Service (MSM):
1. Shri Satya Prakash, Principal Chief Security Commissioner, North Eastern Railway
2. Shri C. S Chengappa, Assistant Security Commissioner, Southern Railway
3. Shri Krishna Kumar Mishra, Assistant Security Commissioner, North Eastern Railway
4. Shri Vivek Verma, Assistant Security Commissioner, North Central Railway
5. Shri Moni Taro, Inspector, Railway Protection Special Force
6. Shri Barun Prasad Laheri, Inspector, Railway Protection Special Force
7. Shri H. K. Doddaiah, Sub Inspector, South Westem Railway
8. Shri Kailash Prasad, Sub Inspector, North Eastern Railway
9. Shri Naresh Kumar, Sub Inspector, Northern Railway
10. Shri Guru Prasad Nagarikanti, Sub Inspector, South Central Railway
ll. Shri Ram Prasad Meena, Assistant Sub Inspector (MT), Railway Protection Special Force
12. Shri E Arun Moli, Assistant Sub Inspector, Southern Railway
13. Shri Vikas Kumar, Assistant Sub Inspector, North Central Railway
14. Shri Niraj Ahlawat, Assistant Sub Inspector, Northern Railway
15. Shri Shankar Shivswami Edle, Head Constable, Central Railway
***
Dharmendra Tewari/ Dr. Nayan Solanki/ Ritu Raj/ Vikas Jha

enrichment.summary: On Independence Day 2026, the President of India conferred the President's Medal for Distinguished Service on Rajesh Lal, Assistant Security Commissioner at the Railway Board, and the Medal for Meritorious Service on 15 other Railway Protection Force (RPF) and Railway Protection Special Force (RPSF) officers and staff across various railway zones.
enrichment.context: These medals are annual gallantry/service honours awarded to police and paramilitary personnel, including RPF/RPSF, on Republic Day and Independence Day as part of a long-standing tradition recognising distinguished and meritorious service in maintaining security on the Indian Railways network. Such awards are administrative and ceremonial in nature and do not reflect any new policy, scheme, or structural change.
